agent.name: AdaBot Trading Agent
agent.strategy: AI short-term scanner + deterministic risk filter

modules.name: AI Short-Term Scanner
modules.description: Scores the supplied crypto snapshot and proposes at most one BUY or SKIP candidate.

modules.name: Deterministic Risk Filter
modules.description: Calculates allocation, target, stop-loss and reward:risk independently of the model.

modules.name: Market Context
modules.description: Publishes observed crypto prices and 24h/30d movement used by the agent.
